privacy_policy: Teaching-only conditions, expected ordered tokens, IDs and opaque ordered-JSON snapshots. No raw SQL rows, timestamps, runtime identity, secrets, progress or private diagnostics.

review_summary.policy: Reuse fifteen sound and distinct existing thematic cases; no new question or link writes. Bounded Ukrainian criteria distinguish grammatical alternatives from the exact target.
checks: All 36 independently captured eligible B1/type-4 questions reviewed under three exact old thematic banks; all ordered instances, original options/pivots, hints, variants and existing pagewide links are bound by opaque full snapshots.
All 36 have empty hints and verb_hints and exactly one original Ukrainian variant. Existing native ComposeTokenCase normalization is used unchanged, with no new token or option presentations.

All fifteen selected questions are distinct reused own-topic cases; no shortage or new question/answer/option/link writes. Existing pagewide links remain sufficient for the unchanged matcher, pending main live acceptance.

Infinitive five cover need, hope, promise with caller/addressee, negative decide and offer. Question 39623 explicitly requests not + to ordering; split to not remains grammatical outside that finite exercise requirement.

Meaning five cover exactly one each of stop, remember, forget, try and regret; effort does not guarantee failure, purpose does not guarantee completion, and questions/reminders do not assert execution.

Used-to five cover former state with current contrast, current be-used-to question, present adapting, future acquisition and past achieved acquisition. Neither familiarity nor acquisition implies liking or skill.

Unselected 40196 has inherited noninitial Forgot not corrected by the unchanged native case helper. Its bad case is not hidden by a long context; all other exclusions are finite coverage choices, not blanket grammar bans.

Main must independently verify exact all-or-nothing matcher bindings, actual live five-question visibility and acceptance; this pure private draft does not authorize SQL or substitute for browser proof.

clone_only_policy.notes: Prepend a finite Ukrainian model/meaning criterion and retain the original Ukrainian condition. No original row, hint, option, answer, link, shared token case, grader or normalizer changes. Unknown or partial decorations must fail closed during main integration.
